Pick the outage groups to follow. Find yours by address on the [oblenergo search page]({search_url}).

site_layout.title: The oblenergo schedule page has changed
site_layout.description: The integration no longer recognizes the schedule page on oblenergo.cv.ua, so the schedule is not updated from it. Meanwhile the oblenergo Telegram channel is used where it lists the hours. Please report this in the project's issues.

telegram_layout.title: The oblenergo Telegram channel has changed
telegram_layout.description: The integration no longer recognizes the oblenergo Telegram channel page. The schedule still comes from oblenergo.cv.ua, but the page is checked every 30 minutes, so changes can show up later. Please report this in the project's issues.
